resources.string: Anyone with the link can claim it
The recipient receives exactly this much. You pay the fees.
Enter more than zero and up to 21,000,000 ZEC, using no more than 8 decimal places
Not enough spendable ZEC for this amount plus fees
This message is too long to fit in a Zpacket link
Advisory only. Nothing on chain enforces it, so the Zpacket still claims afterwards.
Funding cannot be undone. There is no refund and no way to claw the money back.
Whoever holds the link owns the money. Send it privately.
Zapp cannot recover this Zpacket from your seed phrase. Losing this device before you share the link loses the funds.
The Zpacket becomes claimable about 15 minutes after funding.
Keep Zapp open until this finishes.
Share the link with whoever you are gifting.
Claimable in about 15 minutes, once the funding transaction has enough confirmations.
Anyone with this link can claim it. Share it privately, and only once.
This Zpacket is no longer ready to share. Open your saved Zpackets to review its current status. If funding can be retried, Zapp keeps this same Zpacket and link.
Zpackets need a spending key on this device. Switch to a Zapp account to create one.
Zpackets are available on mainnet and testnet only.
Zapp is still connecting. Try again once syncing has started.
The Zpacket could not be saved, so nothing was funded. Try again.
The Zpacket could not be created. Nothing was funded.
The funding transaction could not be prepared. Nothing was sent.
Not enough spendable ZEC to fund this Zpacket and its fees.
Authentication failed, so nothing was funded.
Zapp could not confirm whether the funding transaction was broadcast. Check your transaction list before funding again.
The share sheet could not be opened. Copy the link instead.
Create a wallet to claim this
The ZEC is yours — Zapp just needs a wallet to put it in. Set one up and your Zpacket will be waiting when you get back.
This Zpacket is a few months old
Claiming it means scanning about %1$s blocks, roughly %2$s. Keep Zapp open while it runs.
Keep Zapp open. This can take a while for an older Zpacket.
%1$s is on its way into your wallet.
Your ZEC is confirming on the Zcash network. This takes about 15 minutes; Zapp will claim it automatically. You can leave this screen open.
This Zpacket is not funded yet
The ZEC has not reached this Zpacket yet. Its funding may still be arriving, or another claim may still be resolving. Wait a little, then try again.
Another holder of this link claimed it before this wallet did. No funds were sent to this wallet.
This is not a Zpacket link Zapp understands.
This Zpacket is for a different Zcash network.
This Zpacket claims to be newer than the blockchain. Zapp may still be syncing.
This Zpacket was made with a newer version of Zapp. Update Zapp to claim it — the ZEC is safe inside until you do.
Zapp could not confirm the transfer reached the network. Your ZEC is safe in the Zpacket — try again in a moment.
The Zpacket could not be claimed. Nothing was lost; try again.
This Zpacket cannot cover the network fee to move its own funds. The ZEC is still inside, but Zapp cannot claim it.
Zapp couldn\'t download what it needs to build the transaction. Your ZEC is safe — check your connection and try again.
Zapp could not reach a Zcash server to look for this Zpacket. Check your connection and try again.

Zapp reached a Zcash server, but this phone could not keep up with the search and it stopped making progress. Your ZEC is safe inside the Zpacket. Close other apps and try again, or claim it on another device.
Zapp is still connecting to the Zcash network. Your ZEC is fine — try again in a moment.
This Zpacket link is no longer open. Tap it again where you received it.
This Zpacket is past its suggested expiry. That is advisory only — it still claims for the full amount.
Your ZEC is on its way
Zapp has already claimed this Zpacket for you. It is confirming on the Zcash network, which takes about 15 minutes. There is nothing else to do — check again only if it seems stuck.
No Zpackets yet. The ones you create stay here until you have shared their links.
These links are the only way to reach the funds. Zapp cannot rebuild them from your recovery phrase.
The previous funding attempt is conclusively finished. Review current fees before funding this same Zpacket again.
Funding status unknown — check before re-funding
Checked %1$s — still inside, nobody has collected it.
Zapp has no transaction recorded for this Zpacket, so there is nothing to look for yet.
Another Zpacket is being checked. Each check scans the blockchain, so they run one at a time.
This Zpacket\'s link could not be rebuilt. Do not reset your wallet — contact support.
The share sheet could not be opened. Try again.
This Zpacket\'s funding has not reached it yet, so nobody can have collected it. Check again once the transaction has mined.
Zapp could not finish checking this Zpacket. That says nothing about whether it was collected — try again later.
Zapp could not reach the Zcash network, so this Zpacket was never checked. That says nothing about whether it was collected — try again when you are connected.
Funding was not retried because authentication did not complete.
This Zpacket was not retried because its original account does not have enough spendable ZEC for the amount, claim reserve, and current network fee.
Zapp could not prepare this funding retry. Nothing new was sent — check the Zpacket’s original account and try again.
The retry started, but Zapp cannot yet determine its transaction outcome. Do not retry again; Zapp will reconcile it after syncing.
Retry submitted. Funding is pending; this is still the same Zpacket and link.
Your wallet finished syncing and confirmed the previous funding attempt cannot complete. This creates a new transaction to the same Zpacket and link.
Your Zpacket records could not be read. Do not reset your wallet — contact support.
